import re

def parse_grid_block(text, name):
    m=re.search(rf'{name} \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n?)+)',text)
    if not m: raise ValueError((name,text[:100]))
    h,w=map(int,m.group(1,2))
    rows=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()]
    assert len(rows)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in rows),(h,w,len(rows),[len(r) for r in rows])
    return rows
pairs=[]
